stories.headline: RAM prices could halve by 2028, but don't expect cheaper memory next year
stories.summary: GF Securities' Jeff Pu cut every quarter of his 2027 DRAM forecast and, for the first time, sketched 2028: base case $8/GB vs $16 in 2027 — a halving — with a bear case back at pre-AI pricing. Prices still climb through mid-2027 though, and supply stays short.

stories.headline: GTA 6's unofficial PC port now runs modded multiplayer at 25–30 FPS
stories.summary: French dev TeK got two Jason Duvals synced in the same Leonida instance with proximity voice chat, verified by PortWatch on Nov 26. Single-player AMD builds hit ~22 FPS. Nothing is publicly downloadable — any "launcher" is a scam.

stories.headline: Rockstar's union vote fails — 75% vote against recognition
stories.summary: Rockstar's UK staff voted 1,163 to 381 against formally recognizing the IWGB Game Workers Union, on 93.2% turnout. The union says it will keep fighting; the vote ran Nov 12–26, right through GTA 6's launch.

stories.headline: Team Cherry's 'Cherry Time' airs today with a Silksong Sea of Sorrow update
stories.summary: The special presentation premieres on YouTube today at 9 AM Central, promising "a bunch of exciting announcements" plus an update on the free nautical expansion, which was given a 2026 window. Release date, shadow drop, or delay — nobody knows yet.

stories.headline: Fortnite x Doki Doki Literature Club outfits hit the Item Shop today
stories.summary: Monika, Sayori, Yuri and Natsuki arrive in cel-shaded anime style after days of speculation from encrypted files. No V-Bucks pricing announced yet; shop refreshes 7 PM ET.

stories.headline: South Korea moves ahead with case over Apple's misleading iPhone 16 AI ads
stories.summary: The Fair Trade Commission opened formal proceedings: Apple advertised Apple Intelligence features — including personal-context Siri — as available when they weren't, some landing ~18 months late. Fines could reach ~$36–43M.

stories.headline: Steam overhauls its discounts page for Black Friday — 10x more deals surfaced
stories.summary: Valve replaced fixed promo slots with a permanent personalized hub blending your tastes with what's trending, launching with Black Friday theming through Nov 30. No official Black Friday fest, but the new layout stays for good.
